title: The gaming PC that costs less than your phone

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know your phone could buy a gaming PC?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Smartphone prices are crushing PC budgets right now.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The Acer Nitro 5 starts at just $699 — under most flagship phones.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It packs an RTX 4060 GPU and 16GB of RAM for real gaming power.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Students, streamers, and casual gamers can finally afford high-end specs.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This shift is making PC gaming more accessible than ever before.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What’s your next upgrade going to be?

caption_text: The gaming PC that costs less than your phone
